description: FROZEN train/test split, keyed by star host ID. Generated by reproducing the ORIGINAL positional train_test_split(random_state=42, test_size=0.2) on the 5,491-row dataset that models/best_model.joblib was actually trained and evaluated on. Preserving these exact IDs is what keeps the published test ROC-AUC of 0.9032 valid and comparable across every future retrain.
why_frozen: The original split was POSITIONAL: train_test_split on row indices with a fixed seed. That is only stable while the row count and row order never change. The continuous-retraining label watcher appends new rows, so the split silently reshuffled -- 89 stars the deployed model was TRAINED on had moved into the recomputed TEST set, inflating its measured AUC from 0.9032 to 0.9113. Keying the split to stable star IDs removes that failure mode permanently.
